description: Body-top code that does nothing is a compile error: a bare literal statement (`404`) and a declaration whose grammar is not satisfied (`import stuff`, `type here`, `export data`, `fn heading`) compile nothing, so each is E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT at its own line; the declarations between them survive.
rationale: Ruling user-voice-scrml.md S443 item 4 — compile error (the declared-prose coverage rule: a node covers only tokens it compiles). Round 4 compiled all five silently on the default front end.
